ask: mkae a veto thing for dinnr plz
sentence: Each person gets one veto to strike a restaurant from a short list, and the last place left is picked for the group meal.
use_when: A group can't agree on where to eat and wants to narrow a list by elimination
Everyone should have an equal say by striking one option they dislike
Picking a restaurant for a planned dinner or outing from a few candidates
A quick way to decide among up to 8 options without a long debate
dont_use_when: The group wants to rank or score options or count votes for a favorite (use a poll)
Only one or two people are deciding, or there are not enough vetoes to reach a single winner
The choices are not a fixed list and people need to suggest new options as they go
